name: Born of Elements
text: Due to your natural connection, the tradition of any spells or magical abilities you gain from a yaoguai heritage or ancestry feat is primal instead of its normal tradition (usually occult).

name: Reflection
text: The GM might require you to roll a Deception check in other circumstances, such as if you're mirror-risen and interacting with someone who has seen an accurate likeness of your progenitor and might notice a distinguishing feature on the reverse side.
